1112.name: Instant Reflexes
1112.description: Gain evasion when you use an elite skill.

1130.name: Leeching Venoms
1130.description:
Venom utility skills siphon life from struck foes. Gain stacks of Spider Venom when you enter or exit stealth.
Siphoning can only occur once per strike.

1134.name: Cover of Shadow
1134.description: When you steal, create a field around yourself that grants allies protection. Granting dark aura to yourself removes a condition from nearby allies.</c>

1135.name: Shadow's Rejuvenation
1135.description: Gain initiative when you enter or exit stealth.

1136.name: Meld with Shadows
1136.description: Gain superspeed when you enter or exit stealth.

1157.name: Lead Attacks
1157.description: Increases all damage dealt per initiative spent. Steal gains reduced recharge time.

1158.name: Sleight of Hand
1158.description: Stealing also dazes the target. Reduces the recharge of Steal.

1159.name: Uncatchable
1159.description: Leave behind lesser caltrops when you dodge.

1160.name: Shielding Restoration
1160.description: Grant barrier and dark aura to nearby allies when you use a healing skill.

1162.name: Rending Shade
1162.description: Steal boons from enemies you strike with <c=@abilitytype>stealth attacks</c>. Striking a boonless foe with a stealth attack breaks their barrier instead.

1163.name: Thrill of the Crime
1163.description: When you Steal, you and all nearby allies gain fury, might, and swiftness for 10 seconds.

1164.name: Deadly Ambition
1164.description:
Inflict poison when striking a foe with a dual wield attack. Gain increased condition damage.
Applies poison once per attack use.

1167.name: Improvisation
1167.description:
Use stolen skills twice. Reduce the cooldown of all equipped utility skills when you steal. If you are a Specter, gain additional shadow force while using Siphon on an enemy.
Cooldown effect will only trigger if all utility slots are filled and if at least one of your active utility skills is on cooldown. Does not affect inactive sequence skills.

1169.name: Even the Odds
1169.description: Apply vulnerability when you steal. Apply conditions when you hit with a stealth attack.

1170.name: Sundering Shade
1170.description: <c=@abilitytype>Stealth Attack</c> skills inflict vulnerability and grant fury upon successfully hitting foes.

1187.name: Quick Pockets
1187.description: Gain initiative on swapping weapons while in combat.

1190.name: Pressure Striking
1190.description:
Enemies you interrupt are inflicted with torment.
This trait can only affect enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

1192.name: Swindler's Equilibrium
1192.description: Gain power and additional power while wielding a sword or underwater spear. Successfully evading an attack while wielding a sword or underwater spear recharges Steal.

1209.name: Assassin's Fury
1209.description: Gain might when you gain fury.

1210.name: Unrelenting Strikes
1210.description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike an enemy.

1215.name: Hidden Killer
1215.description: Gain bonus critical-hit chance while stealthed. This bonus lingers for a short duration after you've been revealed.

1232.name: Preparedness
1232.description: Increases maximum initiative by 3. Gain increased expertise.

1234.name: Feline Grace
1234.description: Gain vigor upon successfully evading an attack.

1237.name: Pain Response
1237.description: Dodging removes a damaging condition from you.

1238.name: Assassin's Reward
1238.description: Heal yourself whenever you use a skill that uses initiative. Heal yourself for each point of initiative spent.

1242.name: Fluid Strikes
1242.description: Gain increased strike damage for a period of time when you shadowstep or use a movement skill.

1245.name: Dagger Training
1245.description: Gain bonus power, which is increased when wielding a dagger.

1252.name: Burst of Agility
1252.description: Use Lesser Haste when attacking a foe from behind or from the side or when they are defiant.

1257.name: Exposed Weakness
1257.description: Deal increased strike damage to your target for each unique condition on them.

1268.name: Twin Fangs
1268.description: Deal increased critical damage, which is further increased while your health is above the threshold. Gain bonus critical-hit chance when hitting a foe from behind or the side or when they are defiant.

1269.name: Executioner
1269.description: Deal increased strike damage when your target is below the health threshold.

1272.name: Practiced Tolerance
1272.description: Gain ferocity based on your precision.

1276.name: Mug
1276.description: Deal damage and gain life when stealing. This attack cannot critically hit enemies.

1277.name: Bountiful Theft
1277.description: Stealing grants you and all nearby allies vigor. You rip boons from your target and grant them to nearby allies. Grant additional boons to allies if your target has no boons.

1279.name: Serpent's Touch
1279.description: Stealing inflicts poison. While in the downed state, your attacks apply poison.

1280.name: Lotus Poison
1280.description: Gain might and weaken targets when you poison them.

1281.name: Keen Observer
1281.description: Critical-hit chance is increased, and it is further increased while your health is above the threshold.

1282.name: Ferocious Strikes
1282.description: Gain increased critical damage against foes whose health is above the threshold.

1284.name: Hidden Thief
1284.description: Stealing inflicts blindness. <c=@abilitytype>Stealth Attacks</c> inflict weakness. <c=@reminder>Cannot affect the same target more than once per interval.</c>

1291.name: Potent Poison
1291.description: Poison you inflict has increased damage and duration. Other Deadly Arts traits apply additional stacks of poison.

1292.name: Panic Strike
1292.description: Immobilizing a foe poisons them. Striking a foe with unique conditions equal to or more than the threshold immobilizes them.

1293.name: Shadow's Embrace
1293.description: Remove conditions when you enter or exit stealth. <c=@reminder>This effect also applies to stealth you grant to allies.</c>

1294.name: Merciful Ambush
1294.description: Heal when you enter or exit stealth. Stealth yourself and your target when reviving an ally. <c=@reminder>This effect also applies to stealth you grant to allies.</c>

1295.name: Upper Hand
1295.description:
Gain initiative when you dodge, and gain initiative and regeneration when you evade an attack.
Evading can only trigger this trait once per interval.

1297.name: Shadow Savior
1297.description: Gain dark aura when you steal. Granting yourself dark aura heals nearby allies.

1299.name: Deadly Aim
1299.description: Your pistol and harpoon gun attacks now pierce and have increased strike damage.

1300.name: Cloaked in Shadow
1300.description: Gaining stealth blinds nearby foes. Blinding a foe siphons health from them.

1702.name: Invigorating Precision
1702.description: You are healed for a percentage of outgoing critical-hit damage. This healing is increased while you are under the effects of fury.

1703.name: Don't Stop
1703.description: While you have swiftness, movement-impairing conditions have reduced duration. When you gain swiftness, lose a movement-impairing condition.

1704.name: Revealed Training
1704.description: Gain power, then gain extra power while you are revealed.

1705.name: Shadow Siphoning
1705.description:
Stealth attacks siphon health if they hit.
Cannot siphon the same target more than once per interval.

1706.name: Deadly Ambush
1706.description: Stealing also applies bleeding. Bleeding you inflict deals more damage.

1833.name: Lotus Training
1833.description: Your dodge ability now uses Impaling Lotus, firing daggers at nearby enemies. Gain increased condition damage for a period of time when dodging.

1837.name: Endurance Thief
1837.description: Gain endurance when you successfully steal from an enemy.

1884.name: Staff Master
1884.description: While wielding a staff, gain endurance for each initiative point spent. Gain bonus power, which is increased when wielding a staff.

1887.name: Weakening Strikes
1887.description: Your next attack after dodging causes weakness to foes struck. Weakened enemies deal less damage to you, and you deal increased strike damage to them.

1893.name: Havoc Specialist
1893.description: Strike damage dealt is increased when your endurance is not full.

1904.name: No Quarter
1904.description: Landing a critical hit while under the effects of fury increases the duration of fury. Gain increased ferocity while under the effects of fury.

1933.name: Marauder's Resilience
1933.description: Gain vitality based on a portion of your power. Damage is decreased from foes within the range threshold.

1964.name: Unhindered Combatant
1964.description: Your dodge ability is replaced by a long-range dash that removes inhibiting conditions and grants swiftness and damage reduction. Removing certain conditions in this way temporarily reduces endurance gain.

1975.name: Impacting Disruption
1975.description:
Recharge steal and inflict a pulmonary impact when you interrupt an enemy.
This trait can only affect enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

1994.name: Physical Supremacy
1994.description: Gain access to physical skills. Your maximum endurance threshold is increased.

2023.name: Escapist's Fortitude
2023.description: Gain health and remove a condition whenever you evade an attack.

2047.name: Bounding Dodger
2047.description: Your dodge ability is replaced by Bound, dealing damage to the area after you evade. Gain increased strike damage for a period of time after you dodge.

2078.name: Payback
2078.description:
When Renewing Gaze triggers, this trait restores a portion of the recharge time needed by your healing, utility, and elite skills.
Excludes racial skills.

2084.name: Iron Sight
2084.description: Strike damage dealt to your marked target is increased, and strike damage taken from your marked target is reduced.

2093.name: Be Quick or Be Killed
2093.description: Gain quickness when marking a foe. Your power and precision are increased while under this effect.

2111.name: Maleficent Seven
2111.description: Increase the maximum malice-stack count. Restore initiative and gain boons upon reaching the maximum number of malice stacks.

2118.name: Silent Scope
2118.description: Gain precision. When you dodge roll, gain access to your stealth attack if your malice is above the threshold.

2136.name: One in the Chamber
2136.description:
When you cast a cantrip, gain a random new stolen skill. Stolen skills deal more damage.
(Requires a marked target. Overwrites existing stolen skills.)

2145.name: Malicious Intent
2145.description: Marking a target or striking your mark with a stealth attack will immediately grant malice.

2146.name: Fire for Effect
2146.description: Using a stolen skill grants additional boons to allies around you. Stolen skills will always be Steal Time, regardless of the target's profession.

2160.name: Premeditation
2160.description: Deal increased strike damage for each unique boon you have; concentration is increased.

2171.name: Deadeye's Gaze
2171.description: Steal is replaced with Deadeye's Mark, which unlocks new Stolen skills and malice generation. Stealth attacks consume malice for bonus effects. Gain access to rifles and cantrips.

2172.name: Renewing Gaze
2172.description: Deadeye's Mark recharges if your mark is defeated. Gain regeneration when this recharge occurs.

2173.name: Collateral Damage
2173.description: Trigger Burst of Shadows at your target's location if it dies while marked.

2184.name: Specter
2184.description: Unlock scepter. <c=@abilitytype>Steal</c> becomes <c=@abilitytype>Siphon</c>. Gain access to shadow force through spending initiative, and gain access to the Shadow Shroud ability.

2264.name: Strength of Shadows
2264.description: Gain expertise based on a percentage of your vitality. Torment you inflict deals increased damage.

2272.name: Dark Sentry
2272.description:
Apply <c=@abilitytype>Rot Wallow Venom</c> to allies that you grant barrier to. Outgoing healing to allies is increased.
<c=@reminder>Rot Wallow Venom effect cannot apply to yourself.</c>

2275.name: Consume Shadows
2275.description: Gain stacks of Consume Shadows at regular intervals while in Shadow Shroud. Exiting Shadow Shroud consumes your remaining shadow force and heals allies based on the number of stacks you have gained. Allies that are fully healed receive the rest of the value in barrier.

2280.name: Panaku's Ambition
2280.description:
Gain barrier when you strike foes with a stealth attack. When you apply stealth to allies, you also grant them barrier.
This effect can only be received once and will reset when stealth is removed.

2284.name: Second Opinion
2284.description: A portion of condition damage is converted to healing power. Gain condition damage, which is increased when wielding a scepter.

2285.name: Traversing Dusk
2285.description: Heal allies in the area around you when you shadowstep. Gain shadow force for each ally in the radius. Wells grant resistance on their initial impact.

2288.name: Amplified Siphoning
2288.description: Gain increased shadow force when hitting a foe with <c=@abilitytype>Siphon</c>. Grant increased barrier when targeting an ally.

2289.name: Shadestep
2289.description: Shadow Shroud skills provide additional supportive effects to nearby allies and your tethered ally.

2290.name: Larcenous Torment
2290.description:
Steal health and gain shadow force when you torment a foe.
Does not grant shadow force while in shroud.

2299.name: Shallow Grave
2299.description: Transfer conditions to an enemy when targeting them with Siphon. Remove conditions from nearby allies and your targeted ally when targeting them with Siphon.

2300.name: Hungering Darkness
2300.description: While in shroud, transfer conditions from your tethered ally and cleanse conditions from yourself. Each condition removed in this fashion heals a percentage of your base health and grants your tethered ally barrier.

2337.name: Magpie's Defense
2337.description: Grant yourself barrier when you use a healing or elite skill. <c=@reminder>The cooldowns for this trait are separate for healing and elite skills.</c>

2346.name: Prolific Plunderer
2346.description: Gain an additional artifact slot. Whenever you pilfer, you gain an additional, random artifact. You can use one additional artifact when you pilfer with Skritt Swipe.

2348.name: Combat High
2348.description: Gain Combat High when you use Skritt Swipe, increasing your outgoing strike and condition damage. Lose stacks of Combat High every interval.

2350.name: Exhilarating Ephemera
2350.description: Gain increased damage for a period of time after using an artifact.

2362.name: Enterprising Aristocrat
2362.description: Gain initiative and barrier whenever you use an artifact skill. You take reduced strike and condition damage whenever you have barrier.

2365.name: Repeat Ransacker
2365.description: Reduce the recharge of Skritt Swipe whenever you use an artifact.

2393.name: Possessive Hoarder
2393.description: Artifacts grant boons to allies when used. Offensive and defensive artifacts grant different boons. Barrier granted through Magpie's Defense and Enterprising Aristocrat is now also granted to allies as well.

2400.name: Scoundrel's Luck
2400.description: Gain Scoundrel's Luck whenever you use Skritt Swipe. Scoundrel's Luck allows you to use double-edge skills on cooldown without backfiring.

2403.name: Trinket Collector
2403.description: Steal is replaced with Skritt Swipe, allowing you to pilfer from enemies. Successfully pilfering grants one offensive and one defensive artifact. Only one artifact may be used each time you pilfer, and pilfering overrides any artifacts you already have.

2409.name: Prodigious Pincher
2409.description: You pilfer after using a certain amount of initiative. This trait will override any existing artifacts when triggered.

2423.name: Card Swap
2423.description: Gain access to Reshuffle. Remove conditions from yourself whenever you reshuffle your artifacts or use an artifact skill.

2431.name: Meticulous Custodian
2431.description: Your artifacts have increased effectiveness. Beneficial artifact effects last longer.

1110.name: Throw Gunk
1110.description: Throw gunk at target area to inflict a random condition.

1115.name: Branch Leap
1115.description: Use the branch to leap at your foe.

1118.name: Throw Chain
1118.description: Throw a chain to cripple and immobilize your foe.

1139.name: Healing Seed
1139.description: Periodically grants regeneration and removes conditions from you and your allies.

1148.name: Blinding Tuft
1148.description: Throw a handful of hair, vanishing in stealth and blinding nearby foes.

1162.name: Whirling Axe
1162.description: Spin and attack nearby foes. You can move while spinning.

1167.name: Whirling Strike
1167.description: Strike nearby foes, pushing them back.

13002.name: Shadowstep
13002.description: Deception. Shadowstep to target area. Becomes Shadow Return, which returns you to your starting area and cures three conditions.

13006.name: Death Blossom
13006.description: Dual Wield. Do an evasive attack over your target, striking nearby foes three times. Each hit causes bleeding.

13007.name: Larcenous Strike
13007.description: Dual Wield. Stab your foe and steal boons from them. Deals increased damage if it hits a foe with no boons.

13008.name: Bola Shot
13008.description: Fire a set of immobilizing bolas at your foe.

13010.name: Shadow Strike
13010.description: Dual Wield. Stab your foe, then shadowstep away and shoot them. Unlock Repeater at reduced initiative cost for a short time.

13011.name: Unload
13011.description: Dual Wield. Blast your foe repeatedly with both pistols. Gain initiative if all attacks hit.

13012.name: Head Shot
13012.description: Daze your foe with a head shot.

13014.name: Steal
13014.description: Shadowstep to your foe and steal from them.

13015.name: Infiltrator's Strike
13015.description: Shadowstep to a foe and strike them. Use Shadow Return to shadowstep back and cure one condition.

13016.name: Flanking Strike
13016.description: Dual Wield. Evade and stab your foe.

13019.name: Dancing Dagger
13019.description: Throw a dagger that cripples nearby foes and returns to you.

13020.name: Scorpion Wire
13020.description: Trick. Throw a scorpion wire and pull your foe to you.

13021.name: Withdraw
13021.description: Trick. Cure conditions, then roll backward while healing and evading attacks.

13022.name: Trick Shot
13022.description: Fire an arrow that bounces between nearby foes and inflicts bleeding when striking poisoned enemies.

13024.name: Choking Gas
13024.description: Fire an arrow that dazes enemies on impact and poisons the target area.

13025.name: Infiltrator's Arrow
13025.description: Fire an arrow and shadowstep to the target area, blinding nearby foes.

13026.name: Prepare Thousand Needles
13026.description: Preparation. Mark your current area with inhibiting magic, readying the location to poison enemies.

13027.name: Hide in Shadows
13027.description: Deception. Vanish in stealth and cure conditions. Then gain regeneration and heal yourself.

13028.name: Caltrops
13028.description: Trick. Scatter caltrops that bleed and cripple foes.

13035.name: Roll for Initiative
13035.description: Trick. Evade backward to regenerate initiative and recover from crippled, chilled, and immobilized.

13037.name: Spider Venom
13037.description: Venom. Poison foes with your next few attacks.

13038.name: Prepare Shadow Portal
13038.description: Preparation. Mark your current area with shadow magic, which can be detonated.

13040.name: Shadow Shot
13040.description: Dual Wield. Fire an unblockable shot at your foe, which blinds them, and then shadowstep to them for a dagger strike.

13041.name: Cluster Bomb
13041.description: Fire a cluster bomb at the target area. Detonate in midair for multiple explosions.

13043.name: Detonate Cluster
13043.description: Detonate your cluster bomb in midair.

13044.name: Blinding Powder
13044.description: Deception. Blind nearby foes and grant stealth to nearby allies.

13046.name: Assassin's Signet
13046.description:
Signet Passive: Grants increased power.
Signet Active: Power is massively increased for a short duration.

13050.name: Signet of Malice
13050.description:
Signet Passive: Heals when you attack.
Signet Active: Gain health.

13055.name: Skale Venom
13055.description: Venom. Apply vulnerability and torment with your next few attacks.

13056.name: Prepare Seal Area
13056.description: Preparation. Mark your current area with stifling magic, readying the location to seal enemies in.

13057.name: Prepare Pitfall
13057.description: Preparation. Mark your current area with controlling magic, readying the location to crush enemies when Pitfall is released.

13060.name: Signet of Shadows
13060.description:
Signet Passive: Grants a 25% increase in movement speed.
Signet Active: Gain stealth and swiftness. Remove all movement-impairing conditions from yourself.

13062.name: Signet of Agility
13062.description:
Signet Passive: Grants increased precision.
Signet Active: Refill endurance and cleanse conditions from nearby allies.

13064.name: Infiltrator's Signet
13064.description:
Signet Passive: Regenerates one extra initiative every ten seconds.
Signet Active: Shadowstep to your foe.

13065.name: Smoke Screen
13065.description: Deception. Create a smoke screen that blocks missiles and debilitates foes that pass through. Gain stealth when you leave the smoke screen.

13066.name: Haste
13066.description: Trick. Gain quickness, fury, and swiftness.

13068.name: Shadow Assault
13068.description: Strike your foe repeatedly with a shadowy assault. Evades while active.

13069.name: Flanking Dive
13069.description: Evade your foe and then strike, dealing increased damage from the side or behind.

13070.name: Tow Line
13070.description: Throw a spear that pulls enemies to you. Gain stealth and access to Hooked Spear if this skill hits.

13072.name: Piercing Shot
13072.description: Bleed multiple foes in a line with a piercing shot.

13073.name: Deluge
13073.description: Fire four shots at your foe.

13074.name: Escape
13074.description: Shoot a harpoon and retreat, leaving a trail of poison.

13075.name: Crippling Shot
13075.description: Fire a harpoon that cripples your foe.

13076.name: Ink Shot
13076.description: Shoot an ink shot that blinds foes in a line. Detonate the shot and shadowstep to it.

13078.name: Smoke Trail
13078.description: Detonate your ink shot and shadowstep to it. Gain stealth if enemies are struck by this skill.

13082.name: Thieves Guild
13082.description: Deception. Call more thieves to support you in combat.

13083.name: Disabling Shot
13083.description: Leap away from your foe while firing a crippling shot.

13084.name: Vital Shot
13084.description: Bleed your foe with a shot to the vitals.

13085.name: Dagger Storm
13085.description: Trick. Spin around, reflecting projectiles and throwing daggers that cripple and bleed nearby foes. You can move while spinning.

13087.name: Wild Strike
13087.description: Chain. Strike your foe again, bleeding them. Gain endurance with a successful strike.

13093.name: Devourer Venom
13093.description: Venom. Your next few attacks immobilize foes.

13096.name: Ice Drake Venom
13096.description: Venom. Chill foes with your next few attacks.

13097.name: Heartseeker
13097.description: Leap and strike your foe. The less health your target has, the more damage you cause.

13099.name: Seal Area
13099.description: Create an area that blocks projectiles and prevents enemies from entering or leaving.

13108.name: Lotus Strike
13108.description: Strike your foe and inflict Poison.

13110.name: Twisting Fangs
13110.description: Spin in place, hitting nearby foes. Each hit causes bleeding.

13111.name: Repeater
13111.description: Blast your foe with rapid fire from your pistol.

13113.name: Black Powder
13113.description: Fire a black-powder shot, blinding your target and nearby foes with smoke.

13115.name: Sneak Attack
13115.description: Stealth Attack. Sneak attack with rapid fire from your pistol and make your foe bleed.

13116.name: Crippling Strike
13116.description: Cripple your foe with a final strike.

13117.name: Shadow Refuge
13117.description: Deception. Create a pulsing refuge at the target area that heals allies, cloaks allies in stealth, and reduces damage taken.

13121.name: Poison Tip Strike
13121.description: Poison your foe with a final attack.

13122.name: Nine-Tailed Strike
13122.description: Block your foe and counterattack with a series of strikes. Gain initiative if you are not attacked.

13126.name: The Ripper
13126.description: Stealth Attack. Fire a shot from stealth to bleed your target.

13129.name: Surprise Shot
13129.description: Stealth Attack. Shoot an arrow that bleeds and immobilizes your foe.

13130.name: Break Stance
13130.description: Spend initiative to break your blocking stance and immediately initiate the nine-tailed strike.

13132.name: Basilisk Venom
13132.description: Venom. Your attacks are unblockable and turn foes to stone.

14136.name: Lesser Caltrops
14136.description: Scatter caltrops that cripple and bleed foes.

16432.name: Cloak and Dagger
16432.description: Stab your foe and vanish in stealth, leaving them vulnerable.

16435.name: Shadow Portal
16435.description: Unleash shadow magic at your prepared location, creating a one-way portal for you and your allies. Allies traveling through the portal gain stealth. Weakens foes around the portal's exit.

21778.name: Skelk Venom
21778.description: Venom. Heal yourself. Your next few attacks heal you.

29516.name: Impact Strike
29516.description: Physical. Strike your enemy and stun them.

29639.name: Finishing Blow
29639.description: Deal a downward strike on your foe. Downed enemies struck with this ability are finished.

30077.name: Uppercut
30077.description: Deal a heavy blow with your fist, sending enemies flying.

30135.name: Staff Bash
30135.description: Swing your staff a second time, striking multiple enemies.

30210.name: Hook Strike
30210.description: Stealth Attack. Attack your foes with stealth, knocking enemies down.

30239.name: Lesser Haste
30239.description: Trick. Gain quickness, fury, and swiftness.

30369.name: Impairing Daggers
30369.description: Physical. Fling multiple daggers at a single enemy, inflicting conditions.

30400.name: Channeled Vigor
30400.description: Physical. Channel your energy to gain endurance and health per pulse. Heal for more if your endurance is full.

30434.name: Punishing Strikes
30434.description: Whirl your staff around, striking nearby enemies.

30519.name: Reflexive Strike
30519.description: Physical. Deliver a massive kick that knocks enemies down.

30520.name: Debilitating Arc
30520.description: Strike enemies in front of you and roll backward, breaking immobilizing effects. Gain access to Helmet Breaker.

30568.name: Distracting Daggers
30568.description: Physical. Fire a dazing dagger at your enemy. If this ability interrupts a skill, gain initiative and a temporary damage increase.

30597.name: Vault
30597.description: Leap toward your destination, damaging foes upon impact.

30614.name: Staff Strike
30614.description: Strike your enemies with your staff.

30661.name: Bandit's Defense
30661.description: Physical. Briefly block incoming attacks. Blocking an attack grants access to a retaliatory attack.

30770.name: Pulmonary Impact
30770.description: Physical. Cause a rupture that deals massive damage when this skill ends. This ability cannot critically hit.

30775.name: Dust Strike
30775.description: Spin your staff in the air, creating a vortex of dust around you that blinds enemies and reflects projectiles.

30868.name: Fist Flurry
30868.description: Physical. Strike your enemy multiple times. If all attacks hit, gain access to Palm Strike.

31129.name: Bound
31129.description: Leap into an area, and deliver a massive blow to enemies.

31187.name: Dash
31187.description: Remove conditions and gain swiftness, then rush forward and evade attacks.

31267.name: Impaling Lotus
31267.description: Evade attacks and hurl damaging daggers, dealing multiple conditions to enemies.

31438.name: Essence Sap
31438.description: Throw energy at your target, slowing them.

40436.name: Death's Advance
40436.description: Kneel. Shadowstep forward while granting yourself stealth. While standing within Sniper's Cover, shadowstep to any position within range instead.

40600.name: Kneel
40600.description: Your base and maximum movement speed is reduced. Gain access to kneel skills, which have increased projectile velocity. You can still dodge roll while kneeling. Kneeling is canceled if you swap weapons or use Free Action.

41158.name: Shadow Flare
41158.description: Cantrip. Throw an orb of shadow magic that damages nearby foes at your targeted location. You may reactivate this skill to swap places with the orb. Deals increased damage to your marked target.

41205.name: Binding Shadow
41205.description: Cantrip. Reveal yourself if you are stealthed and remove boons from your target after a short delay. If the foe is your marked target, they are also immobilized.

41372.name: Mercy
41372.description: Cantrip. Lose all malice, instantly refresh Deadeye's Mark, and gain initiative. Gain additional initiative for each stack of malice you had prior to using this skill.

41422.name: Brutal Aim
41422.description: Fire a shot that inflicts vulnerability on your target. Applies additional vulnerability when used against your marked target.

41494.name: Skirmisher's Shot
41494.description: Fire a bullet that inflicts conditions on your target and grants you a boon.

41937.name: Death's Retreat
41937.description: Shadowstep away from your target and lose conditions. Poisons foes at your starting location.

42863.name: Steal Time
42863.description: Grant quickness to allies around you and slow your marked target. Gain stealth if malice is at or above the threshold.

43390.name: Deadeye's Mark
43390.description:
Mark a target, causing your initiative attacks to generate malice when they hit or critically hit your mark. Shadowstep to your target if you are wielding a dagger, sword, spear, or staff in your main hand. Lose malice when the mark ends or when this skill is recast on a new target.
Malice is only gained once per skill use.

43916.name: Double Tap
43916.description: Fire two bullets that grant might if they hit your target.

44087.name: Malicious Death's Judgment
44087.description: Stealth Attack. Reveal yourself and fire a powerful shot at your target that pierces but deals less damage to untargeted foes. If this attack targets and hits your mark, it consumes all malice and deals increased damage for each malice consumed.

44591.name: Spotter's Shot
44591.description: Kneel. Fire a bullet that grants you boons and inflicts conditions on your target.

44695.name: Three Round Burst
44695.description: Kneel. Fire three bullets that grant might if they hit your target.

45088.name: Malicious Restoration
45088.description: Cantrip. Transfer your conditions to your marked target and then heal yourself.

45094.name: Throw Gunk
45094.description: Throw gunk at target area to inflict a random condition.

45672.name: Shadow Swap
45672.description: Swap places with your shadow flare, causing it to detonate and deal damage to enemies at your original location. Deals increased damage to your marked target.

46335.name: Shadow Gust
46335.description: Cantrip. Knock away nearby foes with a burst of shadow magic, then stealth yourself. If this skill hits your marked target, they'll be launched instead.

50379.name: Hooked Spear
50379.description: Spin around quickly, bleeding enemies caught in your spear's path.

50408.name: Burst of Shadows
50408.description: Invoke an explosion of shadows at your marked target's location that blinds nearby foes.

56880.name: Pitfall
56880.description: Unleash your pitfall on the area, knocking down foes and delivering constant damage over time.

56898.name: Thousand Needles
56898.description: Unleash a hail of needles that immobilizes enemies on impact and poisons the ground, inflicting conditions over time.

59526.name: Repeater
59526.description: Dual Wield. Blast your foe with rapid fire from your pistol.

63066.name: Shadow Bolt
63066.description: Fire a projectile that hinders foes and helps allies.

63128.name: Endless Night
63128.description: Dual Wield. Fire a beam that hinders foes and helps allies.

63154.name: Triple Threat
63154.description: Fire three missiles that hinder foes and help allies.

63230.name: Well of Silence
63230.description: Well. Shadowstep to the target area and lay down a well that removes conditions from allies. Gain shadow force for each condition removed. The first strike of the well dazes foes.

63254.name: Twilight Combo
63254.description: Dual Wield. Fire a slow-moving projectile, then fire a quick shot that accelerates the first.

63267.name: Measured Shot
63267.description: Dual Wield. Shadowstep and fire a shot that hinders foes and helps allies.

63275.name: Shadowfall
63275.description: Well. Shadowstep to your target location and drop a well that continuously pulls foes to its center, increasing intensity with each hit.

63276.name: Well of Sorrow
63276.description: Well. Shadowstep to your target location and create a well that inflicts foes with conditions.

63292.name: Well of Gloom
63292.description: Well. Shadowstep to your target location and drop a well that cripples foes and heals allies.

63294.name: Well of Tears
63294.description: Well. Shadowstep to the target location and drop a well that repeatedly strikes foes.

63314.name: Shadowsquall
63314.description: Stealth Attack. Unleash a barrage from the shadows toward your target.

63323.name: Well of Bounty
63323.description: Well. Shadowstep to a targeted point and create a well that grants boons to allies.

63351.name: Shadow Sap
63351.description: Hurl a bolt of unfurling shadows to bolster allies.

68600.name: Sniper's Cover
68600.description: Kneel. Create a barrier of shadows that blocks incoming missiles. For a short period of time, gain access to Death's Advance while kneeling.

69316.name: Death's Judgment
69316.description: Stealth Attack. Reveal yourself and fire a powerful shot at your target that pierces but deals less damage to untargeted foes.

71802.name: Helmet Breaker
71802.description: Leap at your target with an overhead strike that dazes them.

71852.name: Venomous Volley
71852.description: Throw a fan of poisonous axes that leaves spinning axes on the ground.

71854.name: Spinning Axe
71854.description: Throw an axe that bleeds enemies and leaves a spinning axe on the ground.

71864.name: Harrowing Storm
71864.description: Teleport behind your target and drag any spinning axes back at your target. Returning axes also inflict torment, and enemies struck by a number of axes will be immobilized.

71895.name: Recall Axes
71895.description: Pull spinning axes to your target. Axes deal increased strike damage, and enemies struck by a number of axes will be immobilized.

71965.name: Orchestrated Assault
71965.description: Pull spinning axes to your target. Axes deal increased strike damage, and enemies struck by a number of axes will be immobilized.

71967.name: Spinning Axe
71967.description: Throw an axe that bleeds enemies and leaves a spinning axe on the ground.

72896.name: Entangling Asp
72896.description:
Follow Up. Poison your foe with a sweeping strike. Movement-impaired foes are immobilized.
Striking an enemy with a follow-up attack enables finisher attacks.

72924.name: Malicious Ashen Assault
72924.description: Stealth Attack. Attack foes in front of you with a series of strikes, inflicting damaging conditions. The final strike makes them vulnerable. If this skill follows a Finisher skill, it grants initiative. Consumes all malice when striking your mark to inflict torment and increase the damage dealt.

72927.name: Distracting Throw
72927.description: Throw a spear that inflicts conditions on your target. If this strikes a movement-impaired foe, it also inflicts daze. If this skill follows a Finisher skill, it counts as a lead attack and grants a bonus to outgoing damage for a duration.

72986.name: Unsuspecting Strike
72986.description:
Lead Attack. Leap at your foe and inflict conditions. Inflict additional stacks against foes above the health threshold.
Striking an enemy with a lead attack enables follow-up attacks.

72991.name: Shadow Veil
72991.description: Block the next incoming attack. If you block an attack, heal yourself. If this skill follows a Finisher skill, it blocks additional attacks.

73005.name: Ashen Assault
73005.description: Stealth Attack. Attack foes in front of you with a series of strikes, inflicting damaging conditions. The final strike makes them vulnerable. If this skill follows a Finisher skill, it grants initiative.

73041.name: Mantis Sting
73041.description:
Lead Attack. Cripple your foe with a quick strike.
Striking an enemy with a lead attack enables follow-up attacks.

73063.name: Vampiric Slash
73063.description:
Follow Up. Strike your foes and siphon health from them. Siphon additional health from vulnerable foes.
Striking an enemy with a follow-up attack enables finisher attacks.

73145.name: Barbed Spear
73145.description: Swing your spear. If your enemy is far away, throw your spear instead.

76550.name: Forged Surfer Dash
76550.description:
Offensive Artifact. Dash to the targeted location while dropping bombs along your path that detonate after a short period of time, dealing damage and burning enemies. More bombs are dropped the farther you travel. 

For a short time after using this skill, you continue to drop additional bombs at your location.

76582.name: Metal Legion Guitar
76582.description:
Offensive Artifact. Rock out with your guitar, damaging and applying conditions to opponents around you, then slam the ground with the guitar, damaging and stunning opponents in the area. 

For a short time after using this skill, your first weapon skill is replaced with your stealth attack, even when not stealthed.

76601.name: Exalted Hammer
76601.description:
Defensive Artifact. Leap to the targeted area and slam down with an enchanted exalted hammer, damaging enemies while healing and granting boons to allies in the area.

For a short time after using this skill, activating any weapon skill that costs initiative creates an additional healing burst at your location.

76633.name: Forged Surfer Dash
76633.description:
Offensive Artifact. Dash to the targeted location while dropping bombs along your path that detonate after a short period of time, dealing damage and burning enemies. More bombs are dropped the farther you travel. 

For a short time after using this skill, you continue to drop additional bombs at your location.

76674.name: Holo-Dancer Decoy
76674.description:
Defensive Artifact. Summon a holo-dancer decoy that taunts enemies and grants boons to nearby allies. It self-destructs if it is not destroyed, dealing damage to enemies in a large area and granting additional boons to allies.

For a short time after using this skill, the next utility skill you use has reduced cooldown.

76702.name: Exalted Hammer
76702.description:
Defensive Artifact. Leap to the targeted area and slam down with an enchanted exalted hammer, damaging enemies while healing and granting boons to allies in the area.

For a short time after using this skill, activating any weapon skill that costs initiative creates an additional healing burst at your location.

76733.name: Zephyrite Sun Crystal
76733.description:
Defensive Artifact. Dash toward your target, damaging and inflicting conditions on enemies and removing conditions from allies around you when you reach your destination. You evade attacks as long as you are still traveling.

For a short time after using this skill, whenever you use a weapon skill that costs initiative, remove conditions from yourself.

76744.name: Canach-Coin Toss
76744.description: This skill has backfired and cannot be used again until fully recharged.

76784.name: Emergency Jade Shield
76784.description: This skill has backfired and cannot be used again until fully recharged.

76800.name: Holo-Dancer Decoy
76800.description:
Defensive Artifact. Summon a holo-dancer decoy that taunts enemies and grants boons to nearby allies. It self-destructs if it is not destroyed, dealing damage to enemies in a large area and granting additional boons to allies.

For a short time after using this skill, the next utility skill you use has reduced cooldown.

76816.name: Chak Shield
76816.description:
Defensive Artifact. Place an electrified shield at your position that blocks projectiles, dealing damage to enemies and granting barrier to allies within it.

For a short time after using this skill, your weapon skills that cost initiative refund initiative.

76881.name: Antivenom Draught: Backfired
76881.description: This skill has backfired and cannot be used again until fully recharged.

76895.name: Zephyrite Sun Crystal
76895.description:
Defensive Artifact. Dash toward your target, damaging and inflicting conditions on enemies and removing conditions from allies around you when you reach your destination. You evade attacks as long as you are still traveling.

For a short time after using this skill, whenever you use a weapon skill that costs initiative, remove conditions from yourself.

76900.name: Summon Kryptis Turret
76900.description:
Offensive Artifact. Summons a Kryptis turret at your targeted location and fires at the closest foe in range.

For a short time after using this skill, you deal increased damage to enemies that were struck by the turret.

76909.name: Unstable Skritt Bomb
76909.description:
Backfire. The bomb explodes in your hands, damaging you and damaging and knocking down enemies around you. 

For a short time after using this skill, you take increased strike and condition damage.

76966.name: Reshuffle
76966.description: Redraw any artifacts you currently have in your skill slots.

77092.name: Stone Summit Cannon
77092.description: This skill has backfired and cannot be used again until fully recharged.

77192.name: Summon Kryptis Turret
77192.description:
Offensive Artifact. Summons a Kryptis turret at your targeted location and fires at the closest foe in range.

For a short time after using this skill, you deal increased damage to enemies that were struck by the turret.

77277.name: Mistburn Mortar
77277.description:
Offensive Artifact. Shoot an orb that explodes upon impact with the ground, creating a corrupted area that deals damage and applies conditions to enemies. 

For a short time after using this skill, your strikes additionally inflict burning on enemies.

77288.name: Mistburn Mortar
77288.description:
Offensive Artifact. Shoot an orb that explodes upon impact with the ground, creating a corrupted area that deals damage and applies conditions to enemies. 

For a short time after using this skill, your strikes additionally inflict burning on enemies.

77361.name: Inquest Portal Device: Backfired
77361.description: This skill has backfired and cannot be used again until fully recharged.

77397.name: Skritt Swipe
77397.description: Summon a skritt to pilfer artifacts.

78309.name: Zephyrite Sun Crystal
78309.description: Break stuns and dash toward your target, damaging and burning enemies around you when you reach your destination. You evade attacks as long as you are still traveling.

80244.name: Flawless Execution
80244.description: Shoot nearby enemies as you spin, slashing with your sword.

80278.name: Death's Advance
80278.description: Kneel. Shadowstep forward while granting yourself stealth. While standing within Sniper's Cover, shadowstep to any position within range instead.
